pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which plant is the holy basil? (1 mark)
   A. Tulsi
   B. Sal
   C. Beri
   D. Peepal

2. Which element is called Agni? (1 mark)
   A. Air
   B. Space
   C. Water
   D. Fire

3. Which scripture is a Jain book about the life of Lord Mahavir? (1 mark)
   A. Guru Granth Sahib
   B. Dhammapada
   C. Ramayan
   D. Kalpasutra

4. What does Bal Kaand tell about? (1 mark)
   A. The end of the story
   B. The war with the demons
   C. The childhood of Ram and his brothers
   D. The fourteen years in the forest

5. Whose hymns are also in Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji? (1 mark)
   A. Valmiki and Sigala
   B. Prahlad and Siddhartha
   C. Bhagat Kabir Ji and Bhagat Ravidas Ji
   D. Dasharatha and Ram

6. Whom did Ram marry in the Bal Kaand? (1 mark)
   A. Sita
   B. Ganga
   C. Saraswati
   D. Kaikeyi

7. How should you receive prasad? (1 mark)
   A. With your right hand or both hands, and say thank you
   B. With your left hand only
   C. By snatching
   D. By refusing rudely

8. What does sakha mean in the prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Mother
   B. Friend
   C. God
   D. Wealth

9. When is the Gayatri Mantra a good prayer to say? (1 mark)
   A. Never
   B. Only at the market
   C. Only in the night
   D. Before studying

10. What should you do before taking photographs in a Mandir? (1 mark)
   A. Ask permission
   B. Take at once
   C. Use flash
   D. Photograph the murti closely

11. You are sent to buy bread. What is honest behaviour? (1 mark)
   A. Say the bread was more expensive
   B. Bring back the correct change
   C. Buy sweets with the change
   D. Keep some change

12. You find Ksh 100 on the school field. What shows integrity? (1 mark)
   A. Keep it quietly
   B. Spend it on sweets
   C. Give it to the teacher so it can be returned
   D. Give it away

13. Which is polite when alighting? (1 mark)
   A. Leave rubbish
   B. Run into the road
   C. Thank the driver or conductor
   D. Push others

14. How should learners who return lost items be treated? (1 mark)
   A. They should be ignored
   B. They should be thanked
   C. They should be punished
   D. They should be laughed at

15. What should Amina do about the extra money? (1 mark)
   A. Return the extra to the shopkeeper
   B. Keep it
   C. Spend it
   D. Give it away

16. What should you do if you see something online that makes you uncomfortable? (1 mark)
   A. Share it with friends
   B. Keep clicking
   C. Put it back where you found it
   D. Tell a trusted adult

17. What did the Buddha say about a person's words? (1 mark)
   A. They should be false
   B. They should be true, kind and helpful
   C. They should be rude
   D. They should be loud

18. What does Pranayam mean? (1 mark)
   A. Prayer
   B. Breathing exercise
   C. Song
   D. Body posture

19. Why do children work in pairs in yoga? (1 mark)
   A. To argue
   B. To copy
   C. To check posture and encourage each other
   D. To race

20. In Bhastrika, how is the breath done? (1 mark)
   A. Not at all
   B. Only out
   C. In and out with equal strength
   D. Only in

21. Which is a mistake in yoga practice? (1 mark)
   A. Wearing loose clothes
   B. Comparing yourself with others
   C. Following the teacher
   D. Being calm

22. What does karma mean? (1 mark)
   A. Water
   B. Action
   C. Wealth
   D. Prayer

23. What does Param mean in Paramatma? (1 mark)
   A. Small
   B. New
   C. Quiet
   D. Highest

24. What does Prarthana mean? (1 mark)
   A. Wealth
   B. Duty
   C. Rebirth
   D. Prayer

25. How should you behave when visiting a friend's festival? (1 mark)
   A. Refuse to take part
   B. Listen and ask polite questions
   C. Laugh at customs
   D. Shout

26. Which national symbol is raised at Madaraka Day ceremonies? (1 mark)
   A. A flag of a sports team
   B. The school flag
   C. The national flag
   D. A sail

27. What does the Kiswahili word Madaraka mean? (1 mark)
   A. Food
   B. Peace
   C. Power or authority to govern
   D. Freedom of religion

28. Which teaching of Paryushan do children practise when they forgive a friend? (1 mark)
   A. Anger
   B. Revenge
   C. Forgiveness
   D. Pride

29. What is a calendar? (1 mark)
   A. A kind of map
   B. A festival
   C. A way of counting days, weeks and months
   D. A prayer

30. Which is a mistake? (1 mark)
   A. Mixing up Guruvaar and Shukravaar
   B. Learning the table
   C. Making a song
   D. Using a chart

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Explain the main teachings of the Dhammapada. (3 marks)

32. Give three ways of showing respect to any scripture. (3 marks)

33. What is Pranayam? (2 marks)

34. What does yoga mean? (2 marks)

35. Explain how the school can plan a tree planting day that includes learners with special needs. (5 marks)

36. Give three uses of the Indian traditional calendar. (3 marks)

37. Why should a passenger wait for the vehicle to stop before getting off? (2 marks)

38. Explain why balance is important in the four Purusharthas. (5 marks)

39. What is the role of the bell in a Mandir? (2 marks)

40. Describe how to do Sasankasana. (4 marks)

41. Describe how to do Bhastrika. (3 marks)

42. Explain what Punarjanam means. (3 marks)

43. What does Prani Daya mean? (2 marks)

44. Describe Bharat's action after he returned to Ayodhya. (3 marks)

45. List three ideal practices of a passenger when boarding. (3 marks)

46. Explain the words Micchami Dukkadam said at Paryushan. (2 marks)

47. Describe how the boy in the example story practised Asteya. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #5 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Tulsi
   Tulsi is the holy basil plant.

2. D — Fire
   Agni means fire, heat and light.

3. D — Kalpasutra
   The Kalpasutra tells the life of Lord Mahavir.

4. C — The childhood of Ram and his brothers
   Bal means child.

5. C — Bhagat Kabir Ji and Bhagat Ravidas Ji
   It includes holy men of other traditions.

6. A — Sita
   Ram married Sita in Mithila.

7. A — With your right hand or both hands, and say thank you
   Receive with politeness.

8. B — Friend
   Sakha means friend.

9. D — Before studying
   It is a prayer for wisdom.

10. A — Ask permission
   Always ask first.

11. B — Bring back the correct change
   Bring back all correct change.

12. C — Give it to the teacher so it can be returned
   A lost note belongs to its owner.

13. C — Thank the driver or conductor
   Thanking shows good manners.

14. B — They should be thanked
   Thanking encourages honesty.

15. A — Return the extra to the shopkeeper
   Integrity means giving it back.

16. D — Tell a trusted adult
   A trusted adult can help.

17. B — They should be true, kind and helpful
   Right speech.

18. B — Breathing exercise
   Pranayam is control of the breath.

19. C — To check posture and encourage each other
   Pairs encourage and help.

20. C — In and out with equal strength
   Breathing is equal, like a bellows.

21. B — Comparing yourself with others
   Yoga is not a competition.

22. B — Action
   Karma is action and its results.

23. D — Highest
   Param means highest.

24. D — Prayer
   Prarthana is prayer.

25. B — Listen and ask polite questions
   Respect is key.

26. C — The national flag
   The flag is raised and the anthem sung.

27. C — Power or authority to govern
   It means authority to govern.

28. C — Forgiveness
   Paryushan teaches saying sorry and forgiving.

29. C — A way of counting days, weeks and months
   Calendars organise time.

30. A — Mixing up Guruvaar and Shukravaar
   Guruvaar is Jupiter and Shukravaar is Venus.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: Our thoughts shape our actions, hatred is ended by love, control of anger is strength, and doing good brings peace.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each teaching, up to 3.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: Keep it clean, keep it in a high place, wash hands before touching it, listen quietly, follow its teachings (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: Breathing exercises.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for breathing practice.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: To join or unite the body, breath and mind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for join, 1 mark for the three things.

35. (5 marks)
   Answer: Choose a suitable place and get permission, prepare seedlings, tools and water, and give each child a job they can do, such as holding seedlings, filling watering cans or drawing the plants. Care for the trees afterwards.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for permission, preparing, jobs for all, inclusion of special needs, and continued care.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: Fixing festival dates, choosing days for prayers and family events, keeping tradition alive (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: Moving while the vehicle is moving can cause falls and accidents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for danger, 1 mark for safety.

38. (5 marks)
   Answer: Wealth and wishes are good but must follow Dharma. Without balance, chasing money or wishes can lead to cheating and harm, while Dharma keeps us honest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for balance, 2 marks for Dharma guiding the others, 2 marks for an example.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: Worshippers ring it gently to announce that they have arrived.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for ringing, 1 mark for announcing arrival.

40. (4 marks)
   Answer: Start in Vajra Asana, breathe in and raise the arms, breathe out and bend forward, rest the forehead on the mat with arms stretched forward, breathe calmly and come up slowly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for four correct steps.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Sit tall, breathe in deeply through the nose, breathe out through the nose with the same force, repeat slowly a few times, and rest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for sitting tall, 1 mark for equal in and out breaths, 1 mark for slow and rest.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Punarjanam is rebirth. The soul does not die but takes a new body until it reaches Moksha.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for rebirth, 1 mark for the soul, 1 mark for Moksha.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: Kindness to all living beings.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for kindness and living beings.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: He refused the throne, went to ask Ram to return, took Ram's sandals and placed them on the throne, and ruled as a humble servant.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct point.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wait for the vehicle to stop, form a line and do not push, let children and elders go first, pay the fare honestly (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: May any harm I did in thought, word or deed be forgiven.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for forgiveness.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: He found a purse with money, did not keep it, and asked around until he found the owner.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for three points.
